title: Former employee accessed student data
expected_recommendation: Disable the account, revoke active sessions, investigate recent activity, and verify offboarding.

title: Teacher assigned excessive administrator-level permissions
expected_recommendation: Review the permission change, remove unnecessary privileges and restore least-privilege access.

title: Teacher accessed a student outside their assigned class
expected_recommendation: Investigate the access, verify whether an authorized exception exists and restrict access if needed.

title: Bulk download of student records in a short period
expected_recommendation: Review the activity, verify the user's identity and business purpose, and investigate possible data exposure.

title: Vendor accessed student records outside its approved district
expected_recommendation: Block unauthorized access, review vendor permissions, revoke compromised credentials if indicated, and investigate exposure.
